references.text: God promised to drive out the inhabitants of the land before Israel, confirming the promise that the land would be given into their hands.
Moses conveyed God's promise that the land was given into Israel's hand, the same message the spies confirmed to Joshua.
The Lord promised to bring fear and dread upon the peoples, which aligns with the fact that the inhabitants of the land melted in fear.
Rahab reported that fear had fallen upon the inhabitants of the land because of Israel, a fact the spies now confirm to Joshua.
Rahab described how courage melted away among the people of Canaan, just as the spies reported to Joshua.
The Lord confirms that he has given Jericho into Joshua's hand, fulfilling what the spies reported.
Rahab's faith is mentioned in Hebrews, and her role was crucial for the spies' report that the land had been given to Israel.
